title: Puck world silo (puck.silo.configuration.v1)
description: The silo document (puck.silo.configuration.v1) — durable configuration for one Puck.World.Silo process: which worlds it may activate, its declared door budget, where its checkpoints/journals/definitions live, its own state directory, and its clustering membership. Loaded once at silo start (--silo <path>); nothing in it is simulation state. See WorldSiloDefinitionValidator for the checks a document must pass before the silo composes against it.

worlds.description: Every world this silo may activate, keyed by World.

items.description: One world this silo activates. Its own host.authority (read from its definition after load) is the subject its federation key signs as — never this silo's own identity.

world.description: The world id under that owner's container — the grain key's own extension.
world.title: SafeName

keyFile.description: The path to the PKCS#8 private-key file this row signs its outbound federation claims and its own door's admission challenges with.

pinned.description: Whether this row activates at silo start and never idle-deactivates.

extensions.description: The path of this row's host-approved extension configuration (puck.world.extensions.v1) — the same document a local World reads through --extensions-config-file — or null when the row runs no configured operations, connections, observations, embeddings, or participants. Host state, never published inside a document; no two rows share one file.

rootKey.description: Gets the key this world's checkpoint and recovery root is held under: the owner's UUID and the world id.

items.title: WorldSiloWorldRow

budget.description: The maximum number of Pinned rows this silo may activate at start.

type.description: The case-sensitive key in the composition root's extension registry.

settings.description: An object validated by the selected extension before host startup.
settings.$comment: Open payload: this member's shape is decided by an id named elsewhere in the document, never by this generator.

stateDir.description: The root every activated row's container-ephemeral owned-world store resolves its own directory under — the --state-dir counterpart.

kind.description: The membership implementation selected at composition; this distribution supports Localhost.

shutdownSeconds.description: Maximum time, on the silo's clock, allowed for operator or deployment retirement, a pinned reload, or a release control request.

healthPort.description: HTTP health port; retirement requests are accepted only from loopback.

healthAddress.description: The IP address literal the health listener binds. Loopback by default, so a local silo listens on no network interface; a deployment whose load balancer probes the port names its interface, or 0.0.0.0 for every one, here.

observer.description: Optional installed extension supplying host retirement deadlines; absent means no external observation.

type.description: The case-sensitive key in the composition root's extension registry.

settings.description: An object validated by the selected extension before host startup.
settings.$comment: Open payload: this member's shape is decided by an id named elsewhere in the document, never by this generator.

observer.title: WorldSiloExtension

progressTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum age, on the silo's clock, of a completed simulation step before liveness fails; also bounds each health request.

checkpointTimeoutSeconds.description: Longest time, on the silo's clock, a row may hold state its landed checkpoint does not cover before readiness fails.

journalTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum interval, on the silo's clock, without journal progress while appends are pending.

journalBacklogLimit.description: Maximum external mutations waiting for durable journal publication, per row.

telemetry.description: Optional installed extension the silo's logs and narration are also written to, so a host that is deleted after it fails leaves its evidence behind; absent means only the process's own output.

type.description: The case-sensitive key in the composition root's extension registry.

settings.description: An object validated by the selected extension before host startup.
settings.$comment: Open payload: this member's shape is decided by an id named elsewhere in the document, never by this generator.

telemetry.title: WorldSiloExtension

release.description: Optional managed release identity and private deployment-group admission binding.

group.description: The deployment-group key in the private release store.

owner.description: The deployment-group owner's stable container UUID.

expectedRelease.description: The exact immutable release identity this process may publish.

closedGroupRewind.description: Enforces a closed authoritative inventory for intentional rewind. Remote federation and outbound authority claims are refused; ordinary authenticated player connections remain available.

release.title: WorldSiloReleaseManagement

documentDirectory.description: The directory every hosted world document's relative paths (machine content, assets) resolve beside, as a local World resolves them beside its document's file: the directory puck world prepare wrote the composed documents into, inside the authored asset layout the image ships. A relative value resolves against the silo's working directory. null gives hosted documents no directory, and a relative path one authors is refused by name.

issuer.description: The attestation issuer this silo runs for players, or null when it vouches for no one and admits only the keys its worlds' documents pin.

keyFile.description: The path to the root's PKCS#8 P-256 private-key file. Its public key's SHA-256 fingerprint is the domain every vouched player namespace names.

signIn.description: The installed sign-in provider a player presents a credential from, and its settings.

type.description: The case-sensitive key in the composition root's extension registry.

settings.description: An object validated by the selected extension before host startup.
settings.$comment: Open payload: this member's shape is decided by an id named elsewhere in the document, never by this generator.

signIn.title: WorldSiloExtension

subjectValiditySeconds.description: How long a player's issued key binding stays valid before the client asks for another; at most MaximumSubjectValiditySeconds, the verifier's own ceiling.

issuer.title: WorldIssuerConfiguration

schema.description: Gets the document schema tag — SchemaVersion for a well-formed document.
